# IAM Strategy 300 Recognizes Burford's IP Team Members


November 20, 2024


-
-
-
-


Burford is pleased to share that IAM Strategy 300 has recognized five Burford team members as world-leading IP strategists.


We congratulate[Katharine Wolanyk,](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/)[Eric Carlson](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/eric-carlson/) ,[Joshua Harris](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/joshua-harris/) ,[Christopher Freeman](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-freeman/) and[Avik Chattaraj](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/avik-chattaraj/) .


[Access the full list here.](https://www.iam-media.com/survey/iam-global-leaders/2025)
